answer: Each identity binds one registered terraced tea-garden plot below the summit. The registry maps one plot to exactly one identity; no plot backs two identities. The garden must stay tended, a meadow strip along its edge, and inspectors check it each season. Faking one identity locks 3,500 units for 180 days plus 160 units in fees, spent not returned; 100 fakes cost 350,000 units locked 180 days plus 16,000 units in fees. Cheapest cheat: rent a retired grower's plot, 750 units per 180 days, or bribe a clerk 1,300 units to double-register one plot; both fail inspection against the gardener.
